flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:5173/ then Open the meal 'وجبة أ١ تجريبية' from the meal list.
Note the price shown on the meal page.
Get the meal price shown on the meal page and save as {{meal_price}}.
Select the first available time slot (the earlier one), set quantity 1, and click the add-to-cart button (أضف إلى السلة).
Verify an 'added to cart' confirmation appears.
Then open the cart.
Verify the cart contains exactly one line: 'وجبة أ١ تجريبية' quantity 1 from 'QA Kitchen A'.
Get the cart total/subtotal for the meal and save as {{cart_meal_total}}.
Verify {{cart_meal_total}} equals {{meal_price}} (120 EGP, whole number, no fractions).

cart_meal_total.code:
req = network.requests(method='GET', path='/api/v1/meals/90000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000001a1')[-1]
meal = json.loads(req.response_body)
amount = meal['price']['amountMinor'] / 100
return f"{amount:,.2f}".translate(str.maketrans('0123456789.,', '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩٫٬')) + '\u00a0ج.م.'
cart_meal_total.code_js: const req = network.requests({method:'GET', path:'/api/v1/meals/90000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000001a1'}).at(-1); const meal = JSON.parse(req.responseBody); const amount = meal.price.amountMinor / 100; return new Intl.NumberFormat('ar-EG',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(amount) + '\u00a0ج.م.';
